description:
The opportunity


Create secure, intuitive applications and interfaces through which users supervise, interact with and derive value from agentic systems.


What you will be doing


·        Build web, mobile, conversational or embedded experiences for AI-enabled workflows.

·        Develop front-end components, backend-for-frontend services and APIs.

·        Design interfaces for approvals, evidence, exceptions, feedback and human intervention.

·        Integrate identity, role-based access, telemetry and enterprise design standards.

·        Collaborate with users, product owners and engineers through prototypes and iterative releases.

·        Implement automated tests, accessibility requirements and deployment packaging.


What we need from you


·        3+ years in full-stack, front-end or application development.

·        Strong capability in modern web frameworks, APIs, identity and application security.

·        Experience integrating AI services, conversational interfaces or workflow solutions is desirable.

·        User-centered design mindset and comfort working in agile multidisciplinary teams.


Relevant AI technologies and tooling

·        Strong TypeScript or JavaScript capability with a modern web framework such as React, Next.js or Angular, plus backend development using Node.js, Python with FastAPI, .NET or equivalent.

·        Experience integrating streaming LLM or agent APIs, structured responses, tool-status events, citations, feedback capture and resumable or long-running workflow states into user experiences.

·        Familiarity with an agent SDK or orchestration framework such as LangChain and LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework or Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, or equivalent.

·        Experience building conversational or embedded enterprise experiences with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Teams or web applications is desirable.

·        Strong knowledge of OAuth 2.0 or OpenID Connect, role-based access, secure API integration, telemetry, accessibility and automated front-end or API testing.


Measures of success


·        User adoption and task completion

·        Application quality, accessibility and performance

·        Integration reliability

·        Speed of iterative release

·        User feedback and reduction of workflow friction


Key interfaces


·        Other members of the AI Transformation & Agentic Systems Practice

·        PwC sector, functional, cloud, cyber, risk, Responsible AI and change specialists

·        Client business owners, product owners, technology teams and operational users

·        Technology alliance and implementation partners where relevant


Contribution to the practice


·        Support proposals, client workshops and market development appropriate to seniority.

·        Contribute reusable methods, patterns, code, assets and lessons learned.

·        Coach colleagues and participate in the capability’s continuous learning agenda.

·        Uphold PwC quality, independence, confidentiality and risk-management requirements.


#LI-BS1 #LI-Hybrid
